name: Hermes Suite
description: Hermes Agent v0.23.1 with Hermes WebUI 0.52.677. Separate containers, shared persistent data, private gateway API.
short_desc: Self-hosted Hermes AI agent with WebUI
author: NousResearch (Agent) and nesquena (WebUI)

form_fields.label: Hermes gateway API key (minimum 16 characters)
form_fields.hint: Required at runtime. For migrations with a private user-config/app.env defining API_SERVER_KEY, leave this blank. Otherwise enter a unique secret (min 16 characters); Runtipi stores form values in app-data/app.env.
form_fields.placeholder: Leave empty only when configured in private user-config/app.env

form_fields.label: Hermes WebUI password
form_fields.hint: Required at runtime. For migrations with a private user-config/app.env defining HERMES_WEBUI_PASSWORD, leave this blank. Otherwise enter a strong password; Runtipi stores form values in app-data/app.env.
form_fields.placeholder: Leave empty only when configured in private user-config/app.env
